description: Update an existing segment. Only provide the fields you want to change. Get field names from segment_get_schema if unsure. Segment dates must fall within the parent trip dates; use trip_update first to extend the trip. To change a checklist's tasks use checklist_items_add, checklist_item_update, checklist_items_remove or checklist_items_reorder (IDs from trip_checklists). The result lists the saved value of every field you sent, read back from Tineo, so do not call segment_details to confirm the change. On an Activity, Lodging, EventTicket or Parking, fields.placeId (a place_id from places_search) attaches that place the same way segment_associate_place does, replacing the stored address with the place's. Never invent a time: if the user has not given or chosen one, ask, or send the date only (YYYY-MM-DD) in startDateTime and Tineo stores it as time not set. Send a clock time only when the user stated it or a booking shows it. For commercial cruise reservations and sea/port days use cruise_* tools. Never substitute Activity, CruiseActivity or another segment type for a cruise day. Ordinary shore excursions remain valid Activity/CruiseActivity. If cruise tools are unavailable explain the limitation and ask for clarification. Cruise/CruiseDay generic writes require the dedicated cruise tools; their schemas and full reads remain available.

fields.description: Field values to update. Only include fields that should be changed. Send null to clear an optional field; an empty string is ignored and the stored value is kept.

segment_id.description: The ID of the segment to update
